posts.title: "The Algorithms" must innovate and offer real choice, or the government will take control.
posts.description: Australia is already acting to take control of "The Algorithm" of social media companies. At first I thought this was a stupid idea. But I now think its a good idea. There is no social media platform that truly innovates and allows deep exploration of content from a range of perspectives. They always choose what you get to see.
